BLENDED.note: EEVEE keeps the transmittance per channel (forward pass, use_colored_transparency). The means are half-float EXR values, so each channel is within 5e-4 of the Color; the tolerance covers that quantisation.

DITHERED.note: EEVEE stores one alpha, 1 - average(transmittance), for a dithered surface, so each channel is the background times the Color's mean (0.46667). EEVEE measures 0.47025, 0.0036 above that exact mean, at 16 samples; the two renders are identical. The tolerance covers that offset.
